name: Chikugo (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Chikugo city emblem in white: a ring open at the upper hoist with a small stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Chikugo, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1954.

features.role: Chikugo city emblem — a ring open at the upper hoist with a small stylised device
